_note: NOT load-bearing for model resolution on this repo. The canon ai-review reusable resolves the alias from the config it FETCHES from trust_config_repo (vladm3105/aidoc-flow-operations@main), not from this file — see canon ai-review.yml step 'Resolve LiteLLM model', present at ci/v2.16.0, ci/v3.0.0 and ci/v4.0.0 and byte-identical across the first two; at v4 it differs only by the LITELLM_MODEL → LLM_MODEL export rename (v4 BC #5), which does not change where the alias is resolved from. Operations already sets model 'ai-reviewer'. This file is kept because it documents the expected policy at the point a reader looks for it, and because it becomes authoritative if trust_config_repo is ever pointed at this repo. It is declared at schema v2 so that path actually works: canon asserts version == 2 before reading any field, in the block canon marks '>>> CI0014-SCHEMA-ASSERT >>>' — cite that marker, not a line number: it occurs TWICE per reusable (trust job and review job) and moves every release. A v1 file pointed at would hard-fail the ai-review check rather than become authoritative. This _note sits at the root, not inside litellm, because the v2 schema declares litellm additionalProperties:false. Declared per MIGRATION_v2.0.0.md §3. PIN RULE (#606): the $schema tag above MUST equal the tag on .github/workflows/ai-review.yml's `uses: …/ai-review.yml@ci/vX.Y.Z`, and the two move in ONE commit. ai-review.yml is the anchor because this file is its namesake and its is the version assertion above; composition.yml ALSO reads this file (canon composition.yml fetches it from this repo by API — the FT-6 path) at a different tag, and is deliberately not the anchor. Nothing repairs the pin automatically: `--repin` rewrites `uses:` lines under .github/workflows/ only, and canon marks this file safe_to_replace:false in install/templates/manifest.json, so `--update --non-interactive` (and any no-TTY run) keeps the local copy. An INTERACTIVE `--update` does prompt [k]eep/[r]eplace — answer keep: replacing installs canon's whole template body and would discard this _note and every local policy block below. tests/conformance/test_ai_review_schema_pin.py is the only detector.
